title: Check before you gift
text:
Check before you gift. Nice idea, very poor execution. I bought 2 of these as a gift. Fortunately I opened them to show to my daughter. On the first one it was obvious that the print was not even. When I opened the second one, the print was askew as well. When comparing the two glasses, it was apparent that the daily increment sayings were not spaced consistently. I’m very glad I checked these first before wrapping them. I would have been embarrassed to give them with these flaws.

These glasses are being returned.
